vitest.scope: New context contract plus existing chart/tree contract regressions

implemented: Strict source/metadata-only context response parsing binds original operation/site/authority and plan/chart/tree IDs, versions and digests to the reviewed item and ordinal.

Canonical bounded form values preserve native revision strings above 2^53. Duplicate/cross-kind IDs, unknown private fields, invalid mode/limits, stale metadata, malformed hashes/timestamps and continuation claims refuse.
Native item names retain uppercase and underscores. Call/iteration/time/ordinal conversion occurs only after small integer bounds; byte/revision values remain decimal strings.
remaining: Storybook-first pure context panel and typed fixtures, eight locales, visual/interaction review.
Scoped recovery journal/hook and operation-screen wiring; complete UI static/build/browser checks.
Actual App/compiled-CLI/agent capture recovery acceptance, phase/schema/image/linked-admission closure, final review/merge and deployment.
